interactive.label: Fit
interactive.tooltip: Fit the model with the chosen number of states and decode the state path.

interactive.label: Scan states
interactive.tooltip: Fit every state count in the range and score each by AIC and BIC.

interactive.label: Demo trace
interactive.tooltip: Replace the traces by a generated three-state trace with known means and dwell times (a demo, not data).

interactive.label: Save fit...
interactive.tooltip: Write the last fit (states, transitions, dwell times) as JSON.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the model, the state scan and what refutes a fit.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through loading, the state count and the checks of a fit.

interactive.label: Add files...
interactive.tooltip: Choose binned trace files (several are fitted jointly as separate sequences); dropping files on the window does the same.

interactive.label: Remove
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected file (the last one when none is selected).

interactive.label: Clear
interactive.tooltip: Remove every trace file.

interactive.label: n_states
interactive.tooltip: Number of hidden states. Use the state scan rather than guessing: the likelihood always improves with more states, the information criteria do not.

interactive.label: time_step
interactive.tooltip: Duration of one time bin. Dwell times and transition rates are reported in these units; leave at 1 to report them in bins.

interactive.label: Fitting
interactive.tooltip: Baum-Welch settings: iterations, tolerance, decoder, seed, acceleration.

interactive.label: State scan range
interactive.tooltip: The range of state counts the scan scores.

interactive.label: n_iter
interactive.tooltip: Upper bound on Baum-Welch maps. With acceleration, one SQUAREM cycle spends three.

interactive.label: tol
interactive.tooltip: Stop once the log-likelihood gain per iteration falls below this.

interactive.label: random_state
interactive.tooltip: Seed of the k-means initialisation; a fixed seed makes the fit reproducible.

interactive.label: Accelerate (SQUAREM)
interactive.tooltip: Extrapolate the EM fixed-point iteration (Varadhan and Roland scheme S3): the same optimum in far fewer maps when the states overlap.

interactive.label: min_states
interactive.tooltip: Smallest state count to score.

interactive.label: max_states
interactive.tooltip: Largest state count to score.
